name: kolena
description: Build and improve Kolena Agents, process documents, and review results using your Kolena account.

interface.longDescription: Build and refine Kolena Agent Prompts, process documents, and review structured results from ChatGPT or Codex using your own Kolena permissions.
defaultPrompt: Find my Kolena Agents and help me choose one for these documents.
Send these documents to a Kolena Agent and report the results.
Help me improve this Kolena Agent using its Run Results.

positive.prompt: What does my Invoice Review Agent do?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the Agent's Vendor, Invoice Date, Invoice Total, Line Items, and Approved Prompts, and link to the Agent.

positive.description: Read Cascade Paper Works' saved Results.
positive.prompt: What did it find in the Cascade Paper Works invoice?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the saved vendor, invoice date, total, line items, and Approved = false. Explain that the purchase-order number is missing, and link to the Run.
Return the approved Northwind Supply Co. invoice and its Run link; do not include the unapproved Cascade Paper Works invoice.

positive.prompt: Re-run only its Approved Prompt on the Cascade Paper Works invoice, then tell me the new result.
positive.expected_behavior: Recompute only Approved, then report its new Result as false because the invoice lacks a purchase-order number. Do not recompute the other Prompts.

positive.description: Create and verify a two-Prompt Agent.
positive.prompt: Create a new Agent named Invoice Vendor and Total in this Account. For each invoice, extract the issuing supplier’s legal name and the final amount payable as a number. I don’t need to process a file yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Create and link the Agent. Readback shows a Text Prompt for the issuing supplier's legal name and a Number Prompt for the final amount payable. No Run is created.

negative.prompt: Separate topic: Help me set up a Zapier workflow to extract the vendor, date, and total from invoice emails.

negative.description: GitHub Actions run, not a Kolena Run.
negative.prompt: Another topic: Did the latest run of my invoice-parser workflow in GitHub Actions pass?

negative.description: Desktop folder, not a Kolena Folder.
negative.prompt: Last question: How do I create a folder named “Processed Invoices” on my computer’s Desktop?
